name: Webhooks
description: Posts a message to a Slack or Discord incoming webhook from a flow.
author: lucode

settings.label: Webhook address
settings.help: An incoming webhook address of Slack (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) or Discord (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...). Anyone holding it can post to that channel, so it stays on the hub.

flowNodes.label: Send to webhook
flowNodes.description: Posts a message to the webhook in this plugin's settings. Takes "failed" if the address is not allowed or the service refuses. "sent" gives JSON: service, status.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.help: Long messages are cut. Mentions in it do not notify anyone.

blueprints.name: Tell the channel when a card is done
blueprints.description: When a card enters Done, posts it to the webhook. Set the webhook address in the plugin's settings first.
